sets.title: Test 1
sets.src: YLE Practice Tests Plus Starters (2nd ed.) · Teacher's Guide Test 1, Speaking frame (tr.28) · hình: Student's Book tr.19 (thẻ) và tr.21 (tranh)

scene.alt: A street: a café, children, a dog, a cat, birds, a baby, a car

betweenDogBaby.label: between the dog and the baby

hello.say: Hello! My name's Miss Thao. What's your name?
hello.vi: Chào em! Cô tên là Thảo. Em tên là gì?
hints: What's your name?
Say: My name is … / I'm …

intro.say: Look at this. This is a street. There are some people and the sun is shining.
intro.vi: Nhìn này. Đây là một con phố. Có vài người và mặt trời đang chiếu sáng.

example.vi: Đây là một con mèo. (cô chỉ vào tranh)

find.vi: Chiếc xe ô tô ở đâu?
hints: Look at the street. Where is the car?
Is this the car?
Look at the park. Where are the children?
Are these the children?

pick.vi: Thẻ nào là cây đàn guitar?
hints: Look at the cards. Which one is the guitar?
Is this the guitar?

demo.say: I'm putting the guitar on the bicycle.
demo.vi: Cô đặt cây đàn lên chiếc xe đạp.

place.say: Now you put the guitar under the birds.
place.back: Where are the birds? Under the birds.
place.vi: Bây giờ em đặt cây đàn dưới những chú chim.
hints: Look at the birds. Where are the birds?
Where are the birds? Under the birds.
Look at the cards. Which one is the goat?
Is this the goat?

place.say: Now put the goat between the dog and the baby.
place.back: Between the dog and the baby.
place.vi: Bây giờ đặt con dê vào giữa con chó và em bé.
hints: Look at the dog. Look at the baby.
Where are the dog and the baby? Between the dog and the baby.
Is it a flower?
Is it a flower or a tree?
Is it blue or yellow?
Look at the flower. Is it red or blue? Is it yellow or green?
Are there one or two?
Let's count. One, two, three … How many flowers?
Is the baby sleeping?
Look at the baby. Is the baby sleeping or running?

p2.vi: Hãy nói về người đàn ông.
hints: Is he sleeping?
Look at the man. Is he sitting or standing?
Is it a jacket?
Is it a jacket or a hat?
Is it grey?
Is it grey or pink?

qs.say: Do you wear a jacket to school?
qs.vi: Em có mặc áo khoác đi học không?
hints: Yes or no? Do you wear a jacket to school?
Do you wear a jacket when it's cold?
Is it an apple?
Is it an apple or a banana?
Yes or no? Do you eat apples?
Do you like apples?

qs.say: What do you eat for breakfast?
hints: Do you eat cereal?
Do you eat bread or rice for breakfast?
Is it a frog?
Is it a frog or a fish?
Yes or no? Do you like frogs?
Do you like frogs? Is it a yes, or a no?

qs.vi: Con vật em thích nhất là gì?
hints: Do you like cats?
Do you like dogs or cats?

p3.check: Sách ghi 'Take three object cards' nhưng bảng có 4 nhóm câu hỏi; nhóm cuối (What's this? / Have you got a ball? / What sports do you do? or What games do you play at school?) không ghi tên thẻ. Mình suy ra là thẻ ball vì đó là thẻ còn lại. Cô xác nhận giúp.

hints: Is it a ball?
Is it a ball or a book?
Yes or no? Have you got a ball?
Have you got a ball at home?

qs.vi: Em chơi môn thể thao nào?
qs.alt: What games do you play at school?
hints: Do you play football?
Do you play football or basketball?

p4.vi: Bạn của em tên là gì?
hints: Is your friend's name Mary?
Think of your best friend. What's your friend's name?

p4.vi: Bạn của em bao nhiêu tuổi?
p4.note: Sách ghi “How old is he / she?”. Đã đổi thành “your friend” cho học sinh dễ hiểu. Claude đã chỉnh, không phải nguyên văn sách.
hints: Is your friend 8?
Is your friend 8, 9 or 10?

p4.say: Where do you go with your friend?
p4.back: Do you go to the park?
hints: Do you go to the park?
Do you go to the park or to school with your friend?
